channel.title: Last Night On Sports
channel.description: Your daily 5-minute sports recap. Every morning, Marcus and Elena break down last night's biggest games, scores and storylines across the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, college sports, soccer and more, like two friends talking sports over coffee. New episodes every morning. Note: the hosts are AI-generated voices, and episodes are produced with AI tools and fact-checked against the day's results.
